bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.Names}}' | head -1)"
test -n "$db"
q="BEGIN;
INSERT INTO posting_topics(board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,verified_by,verified_at,enabled)
VALUES ('area_bbs','profile',-1003847210571,48,'みんなのプロフ',7880448530,NOW(),TRUE)
ON CONFLICT (board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id)
DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title,enabled=TRUE,verified_by=EXCLUDED.verified_by,verified_at=EXCLUDED.verified_at
WHERE posting_topics.title='みんなのプロフ';
DO \$\$ DECLARE n integer; BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO n FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND ((board_key='area_bbs' AND chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id=48) OR (board_key='video_chat' AND chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1613) OR (board_key='gay_board' AND chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=210)); IF n<>3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_THREE_DESTINATIONS_MISMATCH'; END IF; END \$\$;
COMMIT;
SELECT board_key||'|'||purpose||'|'||chat_id||'|'||message_thread_id||'|'||title||'|'||enabled FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled ORDER BY board_key;"
out="$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "$q")"
{ echo 'PR47_MASTER_PROFILE_3_BOARD_DB=PASS'; printf '%s\n' "$out"; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
